entries.scope: G3 no-IALMob Id-Vg, Vd=0.1 V, exact SProcess topology, Vg=0--5 V; dominant unresolved interval Vg=0--0.6667 V
entries.observation: The qualified contact-boundary ElectricField HFS fallback reduces the three-point fixed-state median error from 1.04443 dex to 0.0196168 dex. After repairing the constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian, all 31 no-predictor points converge and the worst KCL relative error is 7.96e-6, but the self-consistent P95 current error is 0.432753 dex and the fixed-current equivalent threshold shift is 43.2055 mV. Vg=0.1667--0.6667 V retains a nearly multiplicative Vela/Sentaurus current factor of 2.61--2.73. An eight-combination psi/phin/phip frozen-state audit attributes a median 0.403147 dex, or 2.53015x, amplification to self-consistent state feedback; phin is the dominant single family at all four audited biases. At Vg=0.3333--0.6667 V the fixed Sentaurus-state operator ratio is only 1.046--1.049, while the full self-consistent ratio is 2.606--2.731. A Vg=0.5 V read-only region-local interface-pair probe removes oxide-side box contributions from carrier flux only: interface hotspots 3747, 10233, and 4538 improve locally, but the full free-row residual L2 and maximum improve only to 0.650x and 0.895x because silicon-only node 4492 is unchanged. A direct T-2022.03-SP2 MeasureCoefficients.debug audit closes node 4492 from 5.40895e-7 to 1.31409e-10 by replaying the AverageBox edge coefficients; the local one-ring experiment transfers the maximum to node 10235 because coefficients outside the ring remain unchanged. The completed full-Silicon-mesh read-only replay removes that artificial boundary: across 5674 active electron rows, coefficient-only residual L2 and maximum fall to 0.0173075x and 0.0433710x of baseline, respectively, and all frozen hotspots 3747, 10233, 4492, and 4538 pass the 0.5x gate. Candidate Top-12 rankings change, but the new global maximum is only 4.34% of the old maximum, so no material hotspot transfer is detected. Replacing source volumes by direct AverageBox Measure produces no visible additional L2 or maximum improvement, identifying transport couple coefficients as the dominant fixed-state cause. This qualifies an explicit, default-off external AverageBox diagnostic profile and one-Newton A/B; it does not yet authorize a production default, self-consistent reclose, or an approved engine floor.

electron-density reconstruction from psi and QF
mixed-Voronoi node volume in fixed-state SG replay
barycentric versus truncated negative-cotangent coupling in same-bias reclose
removing oxide-side box contributions from interface carrier edges as a sufficient global closure for the Vg=0.5 V fixed state
a density-state or restart-precision mismatch as the silicon-only node 4492 residual cause
a uniform node-4492 incident-edge scaling as a sufficient one-ring closure
AverageBox source Measure as the dominant Vg=0.5 V fixed-state electron-continuity cause
full-mesh direct AverageBox coefficient replay as causing material residual hotspot transfer
uniform psi or hole-QF state feedback as the subthreshold current-amplitude cause
SRH or Auger recombination magnitude as the electron-continuity hotspot cause
drain-side anomalous couple-over-length edges as the dominant remaining feedback location
WP1.5 low-current KCL and line-search floor
missing contact-boundary ElectricField fallback as the sole remaining cause
constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian mismatch as a physical curve-amplitude cause
open_causes: production representation and Jacobian qualification of an explicit default-off LDMOS direct AverageBox transport-couple profile, including region-local Si/SiO2 carrier semantics
whether the fixed-state AverageBox residual closure also removes the electron-QF-dominant amplification during one-Newton and same-bias self-consistent reclose
generalized SRH hole-QF reference convention; low impact on current Id-Vg but material for recombination qualification
entries.expires_when: An explicit default-off LDMOS direct AverageBox transport-couple profile is Jacobian-qualified and a one-Newton plus same-bias self-consistent reclose either closes the phin feedback without hotspot transfer or proves a mesh-converged engine difference; generalized SRH reference semantics are independently requalified, or the exact mesh/discretization contract changes.
